story.originalTitle: Hadjar could miss F1 Dutch GP with Red Bull replacement plan already in place
story.summaryEn: According to Autosport, Racing Bulls driver Isack Hadjar sustained a wrist injury during a gym session ahead of the Zandvoort race weekend and could be forced to miss the Dutch Grand Prix. The team has yet to make a formal decision, but a Red Bull replacement plan is already in place, meaning Max Verstappen could have a different team-mate for his final home race.
detailZh: 哈贾尔或因手腕伤势缺席F1荷兰大奖赛，红牛替补计划已就绪
哈贾尔正在处理手腕伤势，不过红牛尚未做出最终决定。如果哈贾尔无法参赛，利亚姆·劳森将升入红牛主队。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在F1赛历上最后一场主场比赛中，身旁的队友可能换人。据Autosport获悉，伊萨克·哈贾尔在赞德沃特比赛周末前的一次健身房训练中手腕受伤，可能被迫缺席荷兰大奖赛。
洛朗·梅基斯的车队尚未做出正式决定，在现阶段被Autosport问询时也无法发表官方评论，但据荷兰《电讯报》报道，如果哈贾尔确实无法参赛，相关计划已经就绪。
在这种情况下，利亚姆·劳森将升入红牛，再次获得作为维斯塔潘队友的机会——此前他在去年日本大奖赛前被下调。预备车手角田裕毅则将接替劳森在姊妹车队红牛二队的位置，与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档。
红牛仍可等待一段时间再做最终决定，不过车队的主要考量是哈贾尔的康复，希望这位21岁车手至少能赶上两周后蒙扎的比赛周末。
本周早些时候，哈贾尔和维斯塔潘一样，为赞德沃特最后一个F1比赛周末发布了特别头盔设计。这款代尔夫特蓝设计致敬了去年——哈贾尔在荷兰赛道首次登上F1领奖台，随后将奖杯摔成两半。
对劳森而言，若在赞德沃特为红牛替补出战，将是对他本赛季至今强劲表现的回报。这位新西兰车手目前位列车手积分榜第九，是F1四大领先车队之外的最佳车手，除三个比赛周末外均有积分入账。
对劳森来说，这将是他自去年中国大奖赛以来首次代表红牛出战。
如果哈贾尔确实无法参加荷兰大奖赛，这也将标志着角田裕毅重返F1——这位日本车手在去年年底失去席位，只能在2026年接受预备车手的角色。
他正式担任红牛两支车队的预备车手，不过从红牛的角度看，鉴于劳森对2026年赛车的经验，将他提拔至主队更为合理。
2027年，角田裕毅与Meyer Shank 比赛的IndyCar席位联系在一起。
detailEn: Hadjar could miss F1 Dutch GP with Red Bull replacement plan already in place
Hadjar is dealing with a wrist injury, although Red Bull has yet to make a final decision. Should Hadjar be unable to race, Liam Lawson will step up to Red Bull’s main team

Max Verstappen could have a different team-mate alongside him for his final home race on the Formula 1 calendar. Isack Hadjar is dealing with a wrist injury sustained during a gym session ahead of the race weekend at Zandvoort, Autosport has learned, and could be forced to miss the Dutch Grand Prix.

Laurent Mekies' team has yet to make a formal decision and, at this stage, was unable to comment officially when approached by Autosport, but according to Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf, a plan is already in place should Hadjar indeed be unable to race.

In that case, Liam Lawson will step up and get another opportunity at Red Bull as Verstappen's team-mate, following his demotion early last year – ahead of the Japanese Grand Prix. Reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda would then take Lawson's place at sister team Racing Bulls, alongside Arvid Lindblad.

Red Bull can still wait before making a final decision, although the team’s main consideration is what is best for Hadjar's recovery, so that the 21-year-old is at least fit enough to return for the race weekend at Monza in two weeks' time.

Earlier this week, Hadjar – like Verstappen – unveiled a special helmet design for the final F1 weekend at Zandvoort. The Delft Blue design featured a nod to last year, when Hadjar scored his maiden F1 podium at the Dutch circuit and subsequently broke his trophy into two pieces.

For Lawson, a potential stand-in appearance for Red Bull at Zandvoort would be a reward for a strong season so far. The New Zealander sits ninth in the championship standings, best of the rest behind F1’s four leading teams, and has scored points at every race weekend bar three.
For Lawson, this would be his first race for Red Bull since last year’s Chinese Grand Prix

Should Hadjar indeed fail to make the Dutch GP, it would also mark Tsunoda's F1 return, after the Japanese driver was left without a seat at the end of last year and had to settle for a reserve role in 2026.

He is officially the reserve driver for both Red Bull teams, although from Red Bull's perspective it makes more sense to promote Lawson to the senior team given his experience with the 2026 machinery.
For 2027, Tsunoda has been linked with an IndyCar seat at Meyer Shank Racing.

红牛的主要考量是哈贾尔的康复，希望这位21岁车手至少能赶上两周后蒙扎的比赛周末。

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
